name: Perbál (Hungary)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of red, dark blue and black, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Perbál: a white shield with a tree bearing red, blue and black leaves, inscribed PERBÁL.
history: The new municipal arms and flag of Perbál were completed for 1 January 1992; the flag's colours are red, black and blue. Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
